common: Production 2D game sprite sheet of the exact reference character. ONE ACTION ONLY, described below. EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal cells read left to right. SOLID PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF BACKGROUND EVERYWHERE OUTSIDE SUBJECT, NO BLACK OR GRADIENT BACKGROUND, no glow, grid, text, floor, shadows or watermark. Full subject centered, generous 15 percent margin on all sides, consistent anatomical scale and head size matching idle, stable feet baseline where grounded. Side view facing RIGHT. Crisp late-1990s arcade pixel art with dark outline and three-tone shading. Preserve slim adult face, center-parted black hair, round glasses, black shirt, gray suspenders and trousers, fingerless gloves and black-white shoes. In EVERY body pose, LEFT HAND visibly grips the white handle of ONE turquoise blue-green YONEX BADMINTON RACKET beside his torso, slim shaft and oval stringed head with small white Yonex emblem. Racket follows left hand, never strapped or placed on back. Right hand is free for gestures or basketball. Racket remains compact and fully inside cell, preserve body size; no detached FX in body sheets.
actions: walk
Forward walking loop, alternating supporting feet and passing strides, torso upright and fists raised.
backwalk
Defensive backward walking loop, still facing right, alternate feet and lean cautiously back.
run
Running loop with six distinct contact, passing and flight strides.
backstep
Backward evasive hop: guard, lean, push off, short hop, land, settle.
crouch
Crouching transition: lower progressively from standing to deep guarded squat.
jump
Jump sequence: crouched anticipation, takeoff, rising knees, apex, falling, crouched landing.
guard
Standing block: forearms shield head and chest, compress under impact then recover.
crouchguard
Crouching block: deep squat, forearms shield head, compress under impact then recover.
hurt
Hurt reaction: flinch, recoil, arch back, stagger, regain balance, recover; glasses remain on, no blood.
knockdown
Fall and get up: stagger, fall backward, lie on back, turn onto side, kneel, stand; all limbs contained.
roll
Forward somersault: crouch, tuck, invert, roll over back, plant foot, stand.
max
Power-up body gesture: fists clench, bend knees, open arms, shoulders rise, fists lift, settle. BODY ONLY no aura.
eat
Eating gesture: hand to mouth, swallow, lower hand. Empty hand no detached food.
poop
Disgusted face-wiping hurt reaction, recoiling and wiping face with gloved hand, keep glasses, no detached marks.
laugh
Uncontrollable laughing hurt reaction, shoulders shake and head tilts back, mouth open and hands at belly.
intro
Entrance basketball dribbling, bounce an orange basketball close beside right leg; ball fully contained and body size unchanged.
victory
Celebratory dance loop: shuffle feet, rhythmically rock hips and shoulders, facing right.
punch

kick

crouchkick

heavykick

airkick
Airborne kick: tuck knees, lift knee, extend right leg, full contact, retract, landing preparation.
throw

basketball
